pr_title: [PVR] Reminders: Show reminder dialogs only when GUI is fully initialized / user has logged in
pr_body:
Fixes #18006 

[PVR] Show reminder dialogs only when GUI is fully initialized / user has logged in.

Runtime-tested by me on latest master, on Android and macOS.
Fix confirmed working by issue submitter @sualfred 

@phunkyfish do you have some time for a code review?

issue_context.title: [PVR] Reminder feature: Stuck at startup.xml
issue_context.body:
<!--- Please fill out this template to the best of your ability. You can always edit this issue once you have created it. -->
<!--- Read the following link before you create a new problem report: https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Submit_a_bug_report  -->
## Bug report
If a PVR reminder has been set and you startup Kodi at the time when it kicks in,  Kodi will be stucked at `startup.xml` and won't switch to the defined `System.StartupWindow`

### Describe the bug
This is caused by the reminder dialog. 
The very first active window in Kodi is always `startup.xml` and usually there is only a `ReplaceWindow($INFO[System.StartupWindow])`in there. But since the reminder dialog pops in, any `ReplaceWindow()` or `ActivateWindow()` is blocked because of the modal dialog. 
If you press `Cancel` on the reminder, Kodi will be stucked on `startup.xml`. 

Here's a video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fUFoxtIqNmA


## Expected Behavior
Don't show a reminder dialog during the Kodi startup or login process.

## Actual Behavior
Reminder is kicking in as soon as the PVR stuff is loaded, which is going to happen right at the Kodi startup.

## Possible Fix
Don't show the reminder dialog while `startup.xml` and `loginscreen.xml` is active.
Plus:
Since a lot of skins are using own skin setup or startup routines with custom windows I suggest to delay the reminder dialog if the Kodi uptime is below 30s. This should be enough to bypass any other unexpected skin behaviours or skinshortcuts menu generations to win the race condition.

### To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
- Set a reminder for a EPG item that is going to start in a few minutes
- Close Kodi an wait until the selected show is live
- Start Kodi
